decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already captures the required separation between liquids and electrical components and its retail-food-service scope; no additional update or removal is needed.
The Requirement already requires easy bowl removal and cleaning access, and its existing same-message MODIFY adds the retail-food-service and sanitation contexts.
Quick whisk removal for cleaning was already required, and the existing same-message MODIFY captures application in food-service and cleaning contexts.
Maintenance access and component replacement were already required, and the existing same-message MODIFY captures the added food-service context.
The sanitation and trapped-liquid decision does not change the valve mechanism, button interaction, or controlled-flow behavior of this Requirement.
The source does not change spout geometry, orientation, or pour direction, and the candidate already specifies stainless-steel construction.
Considering sanitation during the prototype does not override or modify the existing policy of using off-the-shelf components where practical.
The source does not revise the approved component set or require another BOM; it describes long-term documentation as potentially helpful rather than a current deliverable.
The sanitation decision does not alter the platform height, cup clearance, configuration, or mixer fit.
The source contains no decision affecting branding text, placard placement, logo styling, or display sides.
Cleaning and sanitation considerations do not modify the existing splash-control target or its high-speed mitigation options.
The source does not change the required mixing quality, foam consistency, target texture, or high-speed mixing behavior.
